# PS Steels & Engineering — Complete Profile

PS Steels & Engineering is a full-service steel fabrication workshop based
in Vattambalam, Mannarkkad, Palakkad district, Kerala, India. We serve all
14 districts of Kerala with custom SS (stainless steel Grade 304 and 316),
MS (mild steel), GP (galvanized) pipe and steel pipe fabrication.

Phone: +91 97475 15022
WhatsApp: +91 97475 15022
Email: info@pssteels.in
Address: Vattambalam, Mannarkkad, Palakkad, Kerala 678582
GSTIN: 32EGQPP3743B1ZF
Working hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM to 7:30 PM
Website: https://pssteels.in

## Materials we work with

- Stainless Steel (SS) — Grade 304 and Grade 316
- Mild Steel (MS) — for gates, grills, structural and heavy-duty works
- GP (Galvanized Iron) Pipe — round and square sections
- Steel Pipe — round and square steel pipes for handrails, structures, decorative use

## Services in detail

### 1. SS & MS Steel Fabrication
Custom stainless steel and mild steel fabrication for residential,
commercial and industrial use. Includes design, MIG/TIG welding,
powder coating, polishing and on-site installation across Kerala.

### 2. GP Pipe & Steel Pipe Works
Professional GP pipe and steel pipe fabrication for handrails, gates,
roofing structures, balcony railings, sitout structures and custom pipe
designs. Powder-coated finishing for long life in Kerala's climate.

### 3. Handrail & Staircase Works
Modern SS handrails (Grade 304/316), glass + steel balcony railings,
staircase fabrication, safety and industrial railings.

### 4. Gate & Sitout Works
Main gates, sliding gates, compound and grill works, sitout structures,
decorative steel art, powder coated MS gates.

### 5. Hotel & Bakery Fabrication
Specialised SS fabrication for hotels, restaurants, bakeries, catering
units and commercial kitchens. Includes counters, shelving, exhaust and
chimney hoods, storage and prep tables.

### 6. Catering Counter Fabrication
Custom catering counters, buffet and chafing counters, mobile serving
units, function-ready setups, branded counter finishes.

### 7. Event & Decoration Steel Works
Steel structure support for events, wedding functions, stage setup and
decoration works. Stage and truss frames, lighting frames, reusable
modular setups.

### 8. Marriage Decoration Works
Customised fabrication for wedding stages, decorative arches, mandapam
structures and custom function setups.

### 9. Sheet & Pipe Bending
Precision sheet and hydraulic pipe bending for industrial fabrication
and structural applications. Custom radius and angle, bulk job-work.

### 10. Steel Furniture Works
Customised steel furniture, tables, chairs, racks, storage units,
display and retail furniture, industrial workbenches.

### 11. Custom Fabrication on Demand
100% made-to-order fabrication based on your design, size and site
requirement. Free consultation, site visit and quotation.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Which areas in Kerala do you serve?
A: All 14 districts. Based in Mannarkkad, we travel across the state.

Q: What materials do you work with?
A: SS (304/316), MS, GP pipe, steel pipe in round and square sections.

Q: Is the site visit and quotation really free?
A: Yes. Free consultation, site visit and quotation are standard.

Q: How long for a quotation?
A: 24 to 48 hours after the site visit for typical projects.

Q: Do you offer warranty?
A: Yes, all works carry a workmanship guarantee.

Q: Can you fabricate from my own design?
A: Yes — 100% custom fabrication for residential, commercial and industrial.

Q: Payment methods?
A: UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Amazon Pay, net banking, all major
cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, AmEx) and cash on delivery.
